TRUMP SERIOUSLY CONSIDERS U.S. DIESEL EXPORT BAN

President Trump said the U.S. is “very seriously” considering restricting diesel exports, despite concerns it could push gasoline prices higher.

Trump blamed current fuel pressures largely on attacks against Russian refineries.

items.headline:
US bond market volatility is at historic levels.

The MOVE index jumped +19% last week, its largest weekly increase since April 2025, following "Liberation Day."

This index is also called the "VIX of bonds" and measures the yield volatility of 2Y, 5Y, 10Y, and 30Y Treasuries.
